legacy_root.answer: One-way mirroring copies selected packages from an upstream file-backed registry into a private local registry. Each mirrored blob's sha256 is recomputed locally and must equal the upstream digest; a mismatch raises DigestMismatchError, is never retried, and writes nothing. Stored provenance keeps source as the UPSTREAM identity and records the mirror only under transport.mirrored_by. An explicit deny filter omits the package from both the local index and the blob census. Bind addresses that would be externally reachable require owner_approved_public_mirror; the default is filesystem-private with no socket.

implementation.filter: PackageFilter allow=None means all except deny; deny always wins
implementation.public_socket: none — validate_reachability is the owner gate; no bind()
implementation.retry_policy: bounded backoff x3 on fetch; digest mismatch never retries

owner_approval.note: Catalog owner_approval_required covers standing up an externally reachable mirror. This unit implements the private protocol and the gate; it does not bind a public listener.
